planned_experiments.name: Pure Multi-Physics Asymmetric Scarp + Upward-Continued Potential-Field OOF + 300 m Submodular CELF
planned_experiments.description: Out-of-fold HistGradientBoostingClassifier on Group A (1m LiDAR signed scarp polarity asymmetry |downface-upface|/(downface+upface+4), native has_lidar=NaN mask, seamless 10m 3DEP curvature/lineaments, fluvial chi/ksn knickzones, 100m Sato Hessian ridges) + Group B (19-band geophysics + TMI_up150 depth-persistence ratio + Miller-Singh tilt edge + basin-margin depth_to_base_surf habitat), allocated via lazy-greedy 300 m submodular DTI coverage (37,654 binary dots).

planned_experiments.name: + TIGER Road-Cut / Pluvial Shoreline Decontamination & Hydrothermal/Radiometric Alteration Halo
planned_experiments.description: Adds Group C: Census TIGER/Line 2024 road-embankment scarp decontamination, Pleistocene Lake Lahontan (1332 m) & Bonneville (1463/1552 m) contour bench suppression, GeoDAWN K/Th/U alteration ratios, and label-free INGENIOUS 2 m temperature probes (F2mDAB), spring/well silica-cation geothermometers, and sinter/tufa/travertine upflow seals.

planned_experiments.name: Full CADG-Submod: + Fold-Safe Visible-Catalogue Tip/Relay Continuation & Piedmont-Basin Habitat Weighting
planned_experiments.description: Adds strictly fold-local visible-only structural continuation features (band-passed relay/step-over zone indicator 300 m..3500 m, directional tip propagation lobe, and visible segment host length — all computed exclusively from fold['visible'] and gated by single-feature canary AUC <= 0.90) plus piedmont/basin-margin sample upweighting (depth_to_base_surf >= 200 m) to align off-catalogue predictions with concealed Great Basin geothermal fault habitat.
